{{Quote|Are you one of the orphans?''"<br />"''Uh, sure.''"<br />"''Name of missing or deceased parents.''"<br />"''Oh, uh&mdash;Teff.''"<br />"''Orphan Teff, age, please?''"<br />"''Ten.''"<br />"''Under guidelines, follow me for food and shelter.|CT-4/619 and Boba Fett, on Raxus Prime|<ref name="CF" />}}
'''CT-4/619''' was the designation of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide conflict between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Shortly after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], CT-4/619 participated in a campaign aimed at [[Conquest of Raxus Prime|striking]] against Separatist activity on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]]. Under the command of [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Glynn-Beti]], CT-4/619 was part of a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] strike force that landed on the world near the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Dooku's headquarters|headquarters]]. During the battle, CT-4/619 and a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of clones encountered the young [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who posed as the orphan Teff. Taking Fett with him, CT-4/619 and Fett boarded a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]] and flew to the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] ''[[Candaserri]]''. Later, when the ''Candaserri'' transported additional orphans from other [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] to the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], CT-4/619 worked on demilitarizing the markings on the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of the [[Transport/Legends|lander]] that would take the orphans down to Bespin.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Impossible! There are no humanoid orphans on Raxus Prime, only Jawas. The planet is nothing but a toxic dump.''"<br />"''Nevertheless, General Glynn-Beti, I rescued one and brought him into the gunship, as per instructions.|Jedi Glynn-Beti and CT-4/619 speak on the matter of the orphan Teff|<ref name="CF" />}}
The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] designated CT-4/619 was one of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="DB" /> CT-4/619 served as a [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]]<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|154|CT-4/619}}</ref> in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]], and fought with the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]] to defend the Republic against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="DB" /> He participated in the [[Conquest of Raxus Prime]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], after the Clone Wars [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|opened]] on the barren surface of the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. Led by the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Glynn-Beti]], CT-4/619, along with the rest of the clone task force under her command, engaged the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]<ref name="CF" /> as the clones attempted to halt Dooku's mission to reconfigure the [[Dark Reaper]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].<ref name="VG">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]]</ref> On the surface of [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]], CT-4/619 and a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of troopers encountered the young [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] amidst the ruins of Dooku's [[Dooku's headquarters|headquarters]].<ref name="CF" />

Under the alias of Teff, Fett joined the group as an orphan to receive food and shelter once CT-4/619 and the group had completed their mission. [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] opened [[Laser/Legends|laser]] fire on CT-4/619 and the squad, forcing them to take shelter behind an [[excavation rig]]. Including CT-4/619, the squad's remaining troopers had been reduced down to three, with Fett tagging along with the group. CT-4/619 and the rest opened fire from the cover of the excavation rig, despite being heavily outnumbered. Another trooper fell, though Master Beti soon arrived, drawing the [[Droid/Legends|droids]]' attention from the group to her, allowing Boba, CT-4/619 and the remaining clone to open fire freely without retaliation. With the combined force of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and clones, the droids were destroyed. CT-4/619 led the orphan to a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]] and confiscated Fett's [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], which he had used to defend himself in the [[lightfight]] moments before. CT-4/619 brought Fett into the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] of the LAAT/i, and the clone took one of the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] seats while Fett sat on the floor. The two waited for fellow trooper [[CT-5/501]], as he was to be the co-pilot, before taking the [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] to the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] ''[[Candaserri]]'', which was in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of Raxus Prime.<ref name="CF" />

Before taking off, CT-4/619 informed Master Beti via a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] that he had picked up an orphan while on the mission. With CT-5/501 serving as co-pilot, CT-4/619 piloted the gunship away from the surface. As the gunship rose, a [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid]] attacked the gunship, but the rear [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]] on the LAAT/i destroyed the fighter with a barrage of fire. CT-4/619 answered Fett's questions about the ''Candasserri'' as they neared the [[Assault ship/Legends|assault ship]], and proceeded to dock the gunship in one of its [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]], before taking the orphan to Beti and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ulu Ulix]], and then seeing to his duties in the hangar. The ''Candaserri'' traveled to the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], where the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] crew planned to offload orphans whom they had acquired from numerous [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. Upon arrival, CT-4/619 demilitarized the [[Transport/Legends|lander]] that would take the orphans down by painting out all military related markings on the craft, as Bespin was neutral in the war and its officials wanted no signs of the conflict on Bespin. While demilitarizing the lander, CT-4/619 once again met Fett before the orphan was transported to the floating outpost of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].<ref name="CF" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Remember me?''"<br />"''Not really. Should I?|Boba Fett again meets CT-4/619 before departing for Cloud City|<ref name="CF" />}}
As a clone of Jango Fett, CT-4/619 stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="DB" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> He followed protocol and instructions thoroughly, and was able to hold his ground in a firefight alongside his squadmates despite being vastly outnumbered. Knowing the ''Candaserri'' well, CT-4/619 was able to answer questions from Fett on things such as the starship's crew. Upon meeting Fett before the orphan departed for Cloud City, CT-4/619 did not remember the orphan whose life he had saved.<ref name="CF" />

==Behind the scenes==
CT-4/619 first appeared in the novel ''[[Boba Fett: Crossfire]]'', written by [[Terry Bisson]] and released in [[2002]].<ref name="CF" />
